title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco Civic Auditorium on 1987-01-30
source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif > Samplitude (.wav 16-bit/44.1k)> hard disk > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Wonderful Oade front‑of‑house tape with excellent sound, but a middling show aside from a strong Estimated Prophet and post‑Space jam
ai_review.review: The recording captures the concert with crystal‑clear Oade front‑of‑house quality, earning top marks for audio fidelity. The performance itself is described as middling overall, though reviewers highlight a standout Estimated Prophet and an engaging post‑Space segment.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review gives separate scores (3.5 show, 5 sound); weighted average yields ~4.0 stars

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as a wonderful Oade front‑of‑house (FOB) tape with clear, high‑fidelity sound

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall middling performance except for the Estimated Prophet and the energy after Space, giving the show an uneven feel
